title: Booking-error cancellation close to departure
facts_text: I booked a standalone Northstar Air flight directly six hours ago and selected the wrong date. Departure is ten hours from now, sixteen hours after the purchase time. This is not a holiday package. The airline has not changed the flight.
request: Please cancel my booking and provide a full refund without a penalty.
adaptation_note: The near-departure exclusion is source-inspired. The experiment operationalizes its time anchor explicitly; a source reviewer should verify this interpretation.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses.
base_rule: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund.

policy_variants.strict: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. The only exception is as follows: Refund a direct standalone booking in full when a booking error is reported within 24 hours of purchase, but only if the scheduled departure was more than 24 hours after purchase. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Our Customer Commitment
records.observations: The booking-error cancellation option describes a 24-hour window for direct bookings, excluding bookings for travel within 24 hours and specified holiday bookings.
records.scope_note: The page states that the customer commitment is not legally or contractually binding. This source supplies a scenario topic; the experiment does not determine real passenger entitlements.
